title: Tiny, cute top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#7c6cbf'/>
  <!-- hat body -->
  <rect x='27' y='24' width='46' height='44' rx='6' fill='#6d5da8'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='27' y='24' width='12' height='44' rx='6' fill='#8f7ed9'/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='23' ry='6' fill='#a08ee8'/>
  <!-- band -->
  <rect x='27' y='54' width='46' height='9' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
  <rect x='27' y='54' width='12' height='9' fill='#ffe28a'/>
  <!-- band highlight line -->
  <rect x='27' y='56' width='46' height='2' fill='#fff0b8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkle -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='3' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cute little shine on brim -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='67' rx='8' ry='2.5' fill='#b7a8f0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
